SECTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Settings are grouped by category so you can find what you need quickly.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION.TITLE: Image Compression
IMAGE_COMPRESSION.DESCRIPTION: PNG compression is lossless, so it might not reduce the file size significantly and higher compression values might affect the performance. JPG and WebP compression is lossy.

CUSTOM_MODELS.TITLE: ADD CUSTOM MODELS
CUSTOM_MODELS.DESCRIPTION: Load your own models from a folder. NCNN (.param + .bin) works immediately. ONNX (.onnx) and PyTorch (.pth, .pt, .ckpt, .safetensors) such as HAT, DAT and SUPIR need the optional AI backend.
CUSTOM_MODELS.BACKEND_NOTE: For HAT/DAT/SUPIR and most PyTorch/ONNX models, install the optional AI backend from the Start Menu shortcut “Upscayl-Next - Set up AI backend”.

CUSTOM_INPUT_RESOLUTION.TITLE: CUSTOM OUTPUT WIDTH
CUSTOM_INPUT_RESOLUTION.DESCRIPTION: Use a custom width for the output images. The height will be adjusted automatically. Enabling this will override the scale setting.

DONATE.DESCRIPTION: If you like what we do :)

GPU_ID_INPUT.TITLE: GPU ID
GPU_ID_INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Please read the Upscayl-Next Documentation for more information.
GPU_ID_INPUT.ADDITIONAL_DESCRIPTION: Enable performance mode on Windows for better results.

COPY_METADATA.TITLE: COPY IMAGE METADATA
COPY_METADATA.DESCRIPTION: Keep original image metadata (EXIF) in the upscaled image.
COPY_METADATA.SUGGEST_JPG_DESCRIPTION: For better metadata compatibility across different systems, we recommend using JPG format. Would you like to change?

IMAGE_SCALE.TITLE: Image Scale
IMAGE_SCALE.DESCRIPTION: Anything above 4X (except 16X Double Upscayl-Next) only resizes the image and does not use AI upscaling.
IMAGE_SCALE.WARNING: Anything above 5X may cause performance issues on some devices!
IMAGE_SCALE.ADDITIONAL_WARNING: This may cause performance issues on some devices!

OVERWRITE_TOGGLE.TITLE: OVERWRITE PREVIOUS UPSCALE
OVERWRITE_TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, Upscayl-Next will process the image again instead of loading it directly.

RESET_SETTINGS.ALERT: Upscayl-Next has been reset. Please restart the app.

SAVE_OUTPUT_FOLDER.TITLE: SAVE OUTPUT FOLDER
SAVE_OUTPUT_FOLDER.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, the output folder will be remembered between sessions.

AUTO_UPDATE.TITLE: AUTO UPDATE UPSCAYL-NEXT
AUTO_UPDATE.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, the application will check for new updates and notify you.

CUSTOM_TILE_SIZE.TITLE: CUSTOM TILE SIZE
CUSTOM_TILE_SIZE.DESCRIPTION: Use a custom tile size for segmenting the image. This can help process images faster by reducing the number of tiles generated.

TURN_OFF_NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: TURN OFF NOTIFICATIONS
TURN_OFF_NOTIFICATIONS.DESCRIPTION: If enabled, Upscayl-Next will not send any system notifications on success or failure.

TTA_MODE.TITLE: TTA Mode
TTA_MODE.DESCRIPTION: Enable Test Time Augmentation for better results, such as removing artifacts BUT this will increase the processing time by 8x!

THREADS.TITLE: THREAD COUNT
THREADS.DESCRIPTION: Worker thread split in "load:process:save" format. Leave empty to let Upscayl-Next choose automatically.
THREADS.INVALID: Use the format load:process:save, for example 2:2:2.

AUTO_OPTIMIZE.TITLE: AUTO-OPTIMIZE SETTINGS
AUTO_OPTIMIZE.DESCRIPTION: When you pick a built-in model, automatically apply its recommended scale, tile size, TTA and thread settings. Custom models keep your own settings.

BATCH_MODE.TITLE: Batch Upscayl-Next
BATCH_MODE.DESCRIPTION: This will let you Upscayl-Next all files in a folder at once

MODEL_SELECTION.TITLE: Step 2
MODEL_SELECTION.GUIDE_BUNDLED: Bundled NCNN models work immediately with the Vulkan runtime. Start with Upscayl-Next Standard, or Lite on slower GPUs.
MODEL_SELECTION.GUIDE_CUSTOM: Custom models appear under Imported Custom Models. NCNN (.param + .bin) works immediately; ONNX and PyTorch checkpoints (HAT, DAT, SUPIR) need extra setup.
MODEL_SELECTION.GUIDE_BACKEND: For HAT/DAT/SUPIR and most PyTorch/ONNX models, install the optional AI backend: Start Menu → Upscayl-Next - Set up AI backend.
MODEL_SELECTION.GUIDE_LICENSE: Some bundled models are non-commercial. Check the model name and the bundled notices before commercial use.
MODEL_SELECTION.CUSTOM_MODELS_NOTE: These models are loaded from the folder selected in Settings → Models.
MODEL_SELECTION.NO_CUSTOM_DESCRIPTION: Add NCNN, ONNX or PyTorch models in Settings → Models. NCNN works immediately; HAT/DAT/SUPIR and most PyTorch/ONNX models require the optional AI backend.

upscayl-standard-4x.NAME: Upscayl-Next Standard
upscayl-standard-4x.DESCRIPTION: Best starting point for most photos. NCNN, works without extra setup.

upscayl-lite-4x.NAME: Upscayl-Next Lite
upscayl-lite-4x.DESCRIPTION: Fastest model for low-end GPUs. Slightly lower quality. NCNN, works without extra setup.

remacri-4x.NAME: Remacri (Non-Commercial)
remacri-4x.DESCRIPTION: Natural images with extra sharpness and detail. Non-commercial use only.

ultramix-balanced-4x.NAME: Ultramix (Non-Commercial)
ultramix-balanced-4x.DESCRIPTION: Balanced sharpness and detail for natural images. Non-commercial use only.

ultrasharp-4x.NAME: Ultrasharp (Non-Commercial)
ultrasharp-4x.DESCRIPTION: Sharpness-focused for natural images. Non-commercial use only.

digital-art-4x.NAME: Digital Art
digital-art-4x.DESCRIPTION: For illustrations, anime and digital art. NCNN, works without extra setup.

high-fidelity-4x.NAME: High Fidelity
high-fidelity-4x.DESCRIPTION: Realistic details and smooth textures for all kinds of images. NCNN, works without extra setup.

DOUBLE_UPSCAYL-NEXT.TITLE: Double Upscayl-Next
DOUBLE_UPSCAYL-NEXT.BATCH_DESCRIPTION: Runs every image in the folder through Upscayl-Next twice (2 passes). This significantly increases processing time.
DOUBLE_UPSCAYL-NEXT.DESCRIPTION: Enable this option to run upscayl twice on an image. Note that this may cause a significant increase in processing time and possibly performance issues for scales greater than 4X.

OUTPUT_PATH_SELECTION.TITLE: Step 3
OUTPUT_PATH_SELECTION.MAC_APP_STORE_ALERT:
Due to MacOS App Store security restrictions, Upscayl-Next requires you to select an output folder everytime you start it.

To avoid this, you can permanently save a default output folder in the Upscayl-Next 'Settings' tab.

SCALE_SELECTION.TITLE: Step 4
SCALE_SELECTION.NO_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ALERT: Please select an output folder first

RIGHT_PANE_INFO.SELECT_FOLDER_DESCRIPTION: Make sure that the folder doesn't contain anything except PNG, JPG, JPEG & WEBP images.
RIGHT_PANE_INFO.SELECT_IMAGES_DESCRIPTION: Select or drag and drop a PNG, JPG, JPEG or WEBP image.
RIGHT_PANE_INFO.PASTE_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION: Hit Ctrl+V or ⌘+V to Paste image from Clipboard

GPU_ERROR.TITLE: GPU Error
GPU_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: Ran into an issue with the GPU. Please read the docs for troubleshooting! ({data})

READ_WRITE_ERROR.TITLE: Read/Write Error
READ_WRITE_ERROR.DESCRIPTION:
Make sure that the path is correct and you have proper read/write permissions 
({data})

TILE_SIZE_ERROR.TITLE: Error
TILE_SIZE_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: The tile size is wrong. Please change the tile size in the settings or set to 0 ({data})

EXCEPTION_ERROR.TITLE: Exception Error
EXCEPTION_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: Upscayl-Next encountered an error. Possibly, the upscayl binary failed to execute the commands properly. Try checking the logs to see if you get any information. You can post an issue on Upscayl-Next's GitHub repository for more help.

NO_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ERROR.TITLE: Set Output Folder
NO_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: Please select an output folder first

INVALID_IMAGE_ERROR.TITLE: Invalid Image
INVALID_IMAGE_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: Please select/paste an image with a valid extension like PNG, JPG, JPEG, JFIF or WEBP.
INVALID_IMAGE_ERROR.ADDITIONAL_DESCRIPTION: Please drag and drop an image
INVALID_IMAGE_ERROR.CLIPBOARD_DESCRIPTION: No Image file found in Clipboard to paste!

NO_IMAGE_ERROR.TITLE: No image selected
NO_IMAGE_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: Please select an image to upscale

METADATA_ERROR.TITLE: Metadata Copy Error
METADATA_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: Could not copy metadata from the original image to the generated image. ({data})

METADATA_FORMAT.TITLE: Metadata Warning
METADATA_FORMAT.DESCRIPTION: On some systems, metadata may not be visible in formats other than JPG. Use specific tools to view metadata if needed.
